outputs.explanation: Panel A shows an H&E image plus spatial gene-expression plots (heatmap-style color-coded spot maps). These are heatmaps of spatial expression, not mean/average bar charts, so individual data point overlay is not required.
Panel B consists only of micrograph/RNAscope fluorescence images (H&E and marker staining); it contains no plot of averaged data, so the check does not apply.
Panel C is a scatter/dot plot showing every individual patient's TMPRSS11B transcript value (LUAD n=512, LUSC n=500) with median and CI overlaid, so individual data points are already displayed.

Panel D is a bar graph (mean ± SD) with individual replicate data points (n=3 technical replicates per group) overlaid as dots, satisfying the requirement to show individual data points alongside the average.
